countSemantics: Authored source only; transform nodes separate; effective counts are existing catalog contracts, not expansion by scanner.

concepts.name: Damage expressions and types
concepts.scope: Expression/classification, not applied damage

concepts.name: Healing
concepts.scope: A healing effect requires reviewed context

concepts.name: Temporary hit points
concepts.scope: Temporary HP are distinct from healing and base HP

concepts.name: Attack labels and modifiers
concepts.scope: Attack syntax/property, not a complete attack

concepts.name: Saving throws and DCs
concepts.scope: DC tags alone do not distinguish a save from a check

concepts.name: Ability and skill checks
concepts.scope: A skill reference is not a check or proficiency grant

concepts.name: Advantage and disadvantage
concepts.scope: Prose candidates; positive, negative and example contexts differ

concepts.name: Condition classification/application
concepts.scope: Condition tags are counted as reference leads, not proof of application

concepts.name: Resistance, vulnerability and immunities
concepts.scope: Authored defense versus an inferred bestowed defense

concepts.name: Armor Class and modifiers
concepts.scope: Property/stat, not a recalculated character AC

concepts.name: Hit points, hit dice and thresholds
concepts.scope: Hit dice, base/component HP and thresholds are distinct values, not healing/damage application

concepts.name: Movement and speeds
concepts.scope: Modes and source flags do not supply missing numeric speeds

concepts.name: Range, reach and area
concepts.scope: Range metadata is distinct from an effect area/target

concepts.name: Duration and concentration
concepts.scope: A definition duration is not automatically every effect duration

concepts.name: Targets and restrictions
concepts.scope: Creature-type classifications only partially describe targeting

concepts.name: Costs, charges, uses and recharge
concepts.scope: Amount, pool, consumption and reset are separate facts

concepts.name: Action economy and initiative
concepts.marker: \b(bonus action|reaction|take an action|as an action|initiative|legendary action)\b
concepts.scope: Action bucket identifies owner kind, not arbitrary resource costs

concepts.name: Spellcasting and spell availability
concepts.scope: Spell mentions remain distinct from grants and schedules

concepts.name: Level/slot progression
concepts.marker: \b(higher level|higher levels|each level|level or higher|proficiency bonus)\b
concepts.scope: Explicit table axis differs from prose scaling

concepts.name: Proficiency and expertise grants
concepts.scope: Requirements and grants are separate roles

concepts.name: Prerequisites and equipment restrictions
concepts.scope: Explicit predicates without character eligibility evaluation

concepts.name: Choices and alternatives
concepts.scope: Tag filter is selector syntax, never a chosen grant

concepts.name: Summoning and transformations
concepts.scope: Monster provenance does not define a complete summoning effect

concepts.name: Multiattack and action sequences
concepts.scope: Sequence graphs require semantic review

concepts.name: Triggers and reactions
concepts.scope: Trap trigger field is role-anchored prose, not a typed event

concepts.name: Ongoing and conditional effects
concepts.marker: \b(at the start|at the end|each turn|while|unless|provided that)\b
concepts.scope: Markers cannot establish scope, subject or conditional effect

concepts.name: Rest-based recovery
concepts.scope: Structured spell usage bucket differs from a generalized resource reset

concepts.name: Environmental/exploration context
concepts.scope: Context, light/capacity and rating are not environmental simulation

concepts.name: Vehicle and facility mechanics
concepts.scope: Component/label metadata differs from execution or upgrades

concepts.name: Economy, quantities and roll tables
concepts.scope: Cost/currency units, quantities, examples and name/recipe data are not automatically effects

concepts.name: Ability statistics/changes and senses
concepts.scope: Base scores, associated ability, score increase, sense definition and sense grant differ
